messages:
maria.pm: quick sync — drafting a concise PRD section for fallback behavior. want to capture tiers, region precedence, and model-variant compatibility + rollout acceptance criteria

maria.pm: draft summary: when primary route fails (capacity/latency/error), route order = region affinity -> capacity tier -> compatible model variant -> degraded feature set (no streaming / condensed tokens). if no compatible variant, return explicit 503 with telemetry. acceptance: fallback latency < 250ms extra on p50 for premium, fallback rate < 1% after steady state, no chat session loss during variant switch.

kai.eng: sounds reasonable. two quick q's: 1) how do we define "compatible"? e.g., can we fall back from non-quantized to quantized w/ same architecture? 2) when we switch variants, do we need to warm KV cache?

maria.pm: compat rules (proposal): same architecture family (gpt-like v1/v2), dtype/quantization allowed unless kv-cache schema changes, and tokenizer must be identical. if tokenizer differs -> block fallback. warming: yes for chat sessions — prefer pin-to-variant per session unless routing fails for >30s, then migrate with a migration token and degrade streaming.

jess.sre: pin-to-variant is safer for stateful chat. migration token idea ok but we need strong telemetry to detect increased token-drop. also: add alert if migration rate > 0.5% / 5m.

sam infra: on the KV cache warming: we can async-populate caches for migrated sessions but that adds write pressure. do we accept the cost for premium only?

maria.pm: propose cost split: premium -> async warm, standard -> short-lived pin + degraded responses, free -> immediate degrade (503-style with retry guidance). add to PRD.

kai.eng: rollout plan (suggested): canary 1% traffic (non-critical orgs) -> 10% with synthetic chat load -> 50% -> full. rollback triggers: migration error rate > 0.5%, fallback latency p50 delta > 200ms over baseline, or customer-visible error rate increase > 0.2%.

jess.sre: add alert thresholds and runbook: severity P1 if rollback triggers for premium customers; P2 for standard. oncall steps + isolation checklist is needed.

maria.pm: acceptance checklist to include in PRD: 1) integration tests for compatibility matrix 2) synthetic replay showing KV-warm reduces tail errors 3) perf benchmark comparing baseline vs fallback chain 4) observability: traces for each step of route decision + tag for migration tokens 5) rollout playbook w/ rollback criteria and customer communication templates.

sam infra: minor nit — include scenario where region affinity conflicts with customer-specified region lockdown (private deployments). in that case, fallback must respect tenancy and fail open with 403-like guidance rather than cross-region.

maria.pm: good call. will add explicit exception: private deployments && region_lockdown => no cross-region fallbacks, return clear error and automated support ticket.

kai.eng: edge-case: long streaming sessions where fallback to non-streaming variant would break UX. we should avoid mid-stream switch and instead finish stream then route next request to fallback variant. add to PRD as "no mid-stream migration unless critical error".

jess.sre: also note cache consistency: when we migrate, ensure we mark session as "stale-kv" to avoid reusing incompatible cached prefixes.

maria.pm: great. I'll update the PRD snippet and open a short RFC doc. want quick review on compat matrix table — ping me if you want to add a model family.

deploy-bot: deploy started: routing-fallback-rfc-draft -> staging (build 2026.3.19-21) :rocket:

maria.pm: thanks — will post RFC link once updated. everyone, please react with :eyes: if you reviewed or :thumbsup: if you're ok with current acceptance criteria.
